numeral.purpose: Timer, option key numbers and changing numbers.

shadows.purpose: Cards, options, inputs and secondary buttons at rest.

shadows.name: sheet-lifted
shadows.purpose: Hover state of clickable sheets, with a 2px rise.

shadows.name: flag
shadows.purpose: Every flag, with a 1px hairline ring.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Lifts, the globe turn and other hover movement.

motion.name: duration-lift
motion.purpose: Flag and sheet lift on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen, such as Start.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--foreground, #18181b); color: var(--background, #fafafa); padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; font: 500 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #18181b); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Second actions such as Play again settings.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 12px; font: 500 16px/1.5 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--foreground, #18181b); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #18181b); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Toggle for settings choices such as continents and time.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 14px/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--foreground, #18181b); } .ds-chip-selected { background: var(--foreground, #18181b); color: var(--background, #fafafa); border-color: var(--foreground, #18181b); }

components.name: Answer Option
components.description: One of four multiple choice answers, with its key number.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; width: 320px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); padding: 16px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 12px; font: 400 18px/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-option:hover { border-color: var(--foreground, #18181b); } .ds-option-key { font: 400 14px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--muted, #71717a); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 320px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); padding: 16px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 12px; font: 400 18px/1.4 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--foreground, #18181b); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #71717a); }

components.name: Mode Card
components.description: Home page card leading to a quiz mode, with a large preview and a faint graticule globe.
components.html: CapitalsSee a country, name its capital.
components.css: .ds-mode-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; width: 360px; height: 220px; padding: 40px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #18181b); border: 1px solid var(--line, #e4e4e7); border-radius: 16px; text-decoration: none; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-mode-card:hover { border-color: var(--foreground, #18181b); } .ds-mode-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--foreground, #18181b); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-mode-globe { position: absolute; top: -96px; right: -128px; z-index: -1; width: 352px; height: 352px; color: var(--line, #e4e4e7); transform: rotate(-23.4deg); transition: transform 1000ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-mode-card:hover .ds-mode-globe { transform: rotate(-8deg); } .ds-mode-title { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-mode-desc { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--muted, #71717a); }

components.name: Score Meter
components.description: Vertical meter beside the question: graphite under 50%, ink from 50%, green when full.
components.css: .ds-meter { position: relative; width: 12px; height: 288px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--line, #e4e4e7); } .ds-meter-fill { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; height: 65%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--foreground, #18181b); }

narrative.overview:
Geoquiz should feel like a well-made atlas: calm pages of paper and ink, where the only colour comes from the world itself. Flags and place names are the content and the colour. Everything around them is black, white and grey, drawn with fine lines like a map grid, so the eye always lands on the question.

The pages are spacious and unhurried, but sure of themselves: large confident headlines, a few large surfaces, and soft, lifted sheets that respond when touched. It is made for adults: no cartoon rewards, no bright buttons and no noise. Delight comes from craft, like a flag that lifts on hover or a globe that turns slightly, not from decoration.

Light and dark mode are equal partners. Both follow the same rules, with paper and ink swapped.
keyCharacteristics: Colour comes only from flags, plus green for right and red for wrong.
Fine line work (1px hairlines, the line-globe logo and its graticule) as the signature motif.
Soft, lifted surfaces: gentle shadows at rest, a little more lift on hover.
One sans family (Geist) with big steps in size and weight; mono only for numbers that change.
Calm motion: slow ease-out, transform only, off with reduced motion.

rules.name: The Flags Bring the Colour Rule
rules.body: No brand or accent colour exists. If an element needs to stand out, use ink, size or weight, never a new hue.

rules.name: The Green Means Right Rule
rules.body: Green and red mean only right and wrong (and red also means "this ends the game"). Never use them for decoration, links or emphasis.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes while you watch it (timer, score, counts) uses tabular numerals so it doesn't jiggle.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows always have a downward offset and a soft blur. Never use a hard offset shadow or a coloured glow.

dos: Do let flags and place names be the only colour on the page.
Do use the line-globe motif (logo, graticule) in hairline when a page needs a geographic touch.
Do give every clickable sheet a hover state and a visible keyboard focus outline.
Do keep motion slow, transform-only and wrapped in `motion-safe`.
Do design light and dark together and check both.
donts: Don't add a brand or accent colour, or gradients.
Don't use green or red for anything except right, wrong and ending the game.
Don't put anything colourful or moving near the question during a game.
Don't use emoji, cartoon rewards or confetti; Geoquiz is for adults.
Don't use hard offset shadows or coloured glows.
